test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Pecket**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling and meaning of the selected option are as follows:
 
 
• **Packet: **a small box, bag, etc. in which things are packed to be sold in a shop.
 
• **Example:** Rahul threw the empty **packet **in the dustbin after eating chips. 
 
 
 
• Thus, the incorrectly spelt word is given in **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Palace: **a large house that is or was the home of a king or queen.
 
• **Paint: **coloured liquid that is put onto a surface to decorate or protect it.
 
• **Peddle: **to go from place to place selling something.
